candidate.answerReason: Triangle BOC is equilateral, so BC is a radius. Triangle ABC is right because AB is a diameter, and Pythagoras then gives the chord length.

methods.label: Use an equilateral triangle and a right triangle
methods.explanation:
The radius is \(5/2\) inches, so \(OB=OC=5/2\). Thus triangle \(BOC\) is isosceles. Its vertex angle is \(60^\circ\), so its other two angles are also \(60^\circ\). It is equilateral, giving
\[
BC=\frac52.
\]
Because \(AB\) is a diameter and \(C\) lies on the circle, \(\angle ACB=90^\circ\). This makes \(AB=5\) the hypotenuse of right triangle \(ABC\). By the Pythagorean theorem,
\[
AC^2=AB^2-BC^2
=25-\frac{25}{4}
=\frac{75}{4}.
\]
Taking the positive square root, since \(AC\) is a length, gives \(\boxed{AC=\dfrac{5\sqrt3}{2}}\) inches, choice \(\mathrm C\).
methods.levelReason: Equilateral-triangle recognition, the angle subtended by a diameter, and Pythagoras provide an elementary geometry solution.
